summary.en: Discover and open Settings pages and manage owner-scoped App permission requests and revocations through the OS.
List installed verified Apps visible to this owner, with quarantine errors. Does not grant their permissions.

why.en: Inspect and manage owner-scoped App permission policy through the OS; never approve grants.

summary.en: Show declared permissions, owner/App enablement, current daemon grants, unsupported direct-resource permissions, and pending/recent changes.

why.en: Inspect this owner's App permission policy without inheriting the target's grants.

summary.en: Request restoration of a revoked, declared brokered permission. Returns pending, not granted. A human must use the OS approval gate or cos review; neither Settings GUI nor MCP can approve. Manifest/caller ceilings remain unchanged.

label.en: Why restoration is needed; not an approval.

why.en: Request trusted human restoration of this owner's declared App permission.

summary.en: Revoke one declared brokered permission for this owner and target App. Invalidates that App's live daemon grants; restart/retry is required. Direct-resource permissions are rejected, never reported revoked.

why.en: Revoke only this owner's selected App permission, without a global owner/session wipe.

summary.en: List every settings page this build exposes, including its id, label, and hint.
Case-insensitively search settings page ids, labels, and hints.

label.en: Maximum matches; values are clamped to 1 through 20.

summary.en: Open Settings, optionally jumping directly to a page.

label.en: Page id such as wireless or appearance.

why.en: Open the native Settings application for the user.
